_comment: Hand-maintained policy. The SSR code ranges themselves live in ssr_pool.json, generated from the EUROCONTROL CAL by tools/build_pool.py.
_modeS: ICAO region prefixes of the Mode S participating states, used to decide whether a flight's DESTINATION is in the area. Must match the PARTICIPATING list in tools/build_modes_area.py that produced modes_area.geojson.
_exclusions: Codes inside a CAL range that must never be issued. The conspicuity, default and emergency codes above are excluded automatically and do not need listing here.
